workflow: Manual data entry of invoice details from PDFs into accounting software (QuickBooks, Xero). Each invoice requires copying line items, amounts, dates, and vendor info.
trigger: Receipt of invoices via email or portal
current_workaround: Human manually types or copy-pastes each field from PDF to accounting system
consequence: High error rate (wrong amounts, duplicate entries), late payment penalties, hours of tedious work per week

workflow: Daily reconciliation of Shopify sales orders against inventory counts in a spreadsheet. Must export sales data, compare with physical stock, adjust quantities manually.
current_workaround: Export CSV from Shopify, open in Excel, manually compare with inventory spreadsheet, update quantities
consequence: Stockouts or overselling due to lag in data; lost sales and customer dissatisfaction

workflow: Weekly aggregation of performance data from Google Analytics, Facebook Ads Manager, and CRM into a single Excel report. Requires manual export, formatting, and formula creation.
current_workaround: Log into each platform, export CSV, open in Excel, copy/paste into template, adjust formulas
consequence: Reports are delayed, inconsistent, and consume 4-6 hours per week; insights are stale by the time they are shared
